summary.text: Don McLaughlin is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 80 who has served since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Cecilia Castellano is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Don McLaughlin's career experience includes owning a business and serving as mayor of Uvalde, Texas, according to Ballotpedia.
He has served as a founding member of the Cactus Jack Foundation.
He assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Tracy King, and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.
